recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. No current FHIR core source follow-up is needed for FHIR-13331; any STU3 historical-publication correction should be handled separately by humans if desired.
issue_request: FHIR-13331 requested that StructureDefinition.type work for logical models: the Jira description said a code-valued type did not support logical-model URLs, and the final resolution required sdf-11 to stop forcing logical-model root paths while adding guidance that logical-model element paths/type names align with the final part of the logical-model canonical/type URL.
initial_application: Git-svn commit 55ebc20f189e7dd4efc817a098fd7c82386b2a43, `#13331 - fix sdf-11 for logical models`, changed the StructureDefinition spreadsheet so sdf-11 became `kind != 'logical' implies snapshot.empty() or snapshot.element.first().path = type` and added logical-model URL-tail/type-name guidance. Later commit 52f82f6efccdd925b78353aadd1b0d5b61e022aa changed StructureDefinition.type from code to uri, added relative/absolute URL wording, and changed the StructureDefinition type search parameter from token to uri, even though that commit message was tagged for an unrelated Questionnaire Jira.
additional_context: The active build includes StructureDefinition. Current source keeps the logical-model sdf-11 exception, defines StructureDefinition.type as uri, requires absolute URLs for logical models, and includes later FHIR-33065 clarification that logical-model type SHALL be a fully specified URL whose final path segment should align with the type name. FHIR-13354 is a duplicate of this issue. FHIR-25777 later records that FHIR-13331 was applied in R4 but not STU3, and both FHIR-25777 and FHIR-33065 are already represented on the combined branch.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. The current StructureDefinition source, search parameter metadata, and build configuration already satisfy the issue in the current build scope.
